name: symset2
prompt: A matching set of 9 premium slot-machine symbol icons for a gas-station themed slot game, laid out in a neat 3 by 3 grid with clear transparent space between them, each icon centred in its cell and filling about 85% of it. All nine drawn by the same top-tier slot-game artist in ONE consistent style: bold, chunky, slightly exaggerated toy-like shapes, front-facing or a gentle three-quarter view, very clean thick dark outline, smooth glossy candy-like shading with bright saturated colours, crisp white specular highlights, a soft warm rim light, strong readable silhouettes that read instantly at small size, no tiny clutter, no text except where stated. Row 1 (the TOP-paying symbols, richer and more ornate, with gold accents and a subtle sparkle): a gleaming red-and-gold cash register with its drawer open, stuffed with green banknotes and gold coins; a big shiny gold car key on a ring with a red tag stamped FALCOS; a bold red gas-pump nozzle with a chrome spout and a curl of black hose. Row 2: a chunky cobalt-blue jerry can with a chrome cap; a bright green energy-drink can with a yellow lightning bolt, beaded with cold droplets; a tall slushie cup with a red-and-blue swirl dome and a striped straw. Row 3 (the LOW symbols, simpler and smaller): a hot dog in a soft bun with a zig-zag of yellow mustard; a puffy orange bag of potato chips with chips spilling out; a pink frosted donut with rainbow sprinkles. Fully transparent background, no grid lines, no frames, no shadows on the ground.
